note: Installer runs before live counting started (launch, Sep 26 PT, up to the first production deploy of api/hook.js). Recorded data only, never an estimate.
source: Vercel Observability metric vercel.request.count for project lastagentcall, filtered to request_path /bin/lastcall-hook.sh, grouped by day, client_ip, client_user_agent, environment and hostname. Retention covers the whole window (first requests on 2026-09-27 UTC).
method: Same rule as live counting: production downloads of /bin/lastcall-hook.sh by curl (only install.sh downloads that file, in every released version), one per network per UTC day.
excluded: 71.198.95.223 is the Affirmi build network (Gilbert and Paws share it), so these are our own launch tests. Preview deployments and the 2026-10-02 verification runs (174.221.106.49) are excluded too. No other network downloaded the hook in the window.
checked_and_not_used: GitHub traffic for affirmitv/lastagentcall (clones 2026-09-27..10-01: 91 clones, 55 unique cloners): a clone is not an install and cannot be told apart from bots, CI and our own agents, and live counting does not count checkout installs either.
AppSpace log drain to app_logs: the drain is attached only to the AppSpace web project, so lastagentcall requests were never sent there.
Vercel request logs API: retains only the last few minutes of requests for this project, nothing from the window.
Downloads of /install.sh and /SHA256SUMS by browsers, crawlers and a Linux curl: they fetch those files but never the hook, so no install ran.
